summary: Full backend + frontend test of upgraded Question Bank (بنك الأسئلة). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed — paginated list contract {questions,total,page,pages}, grade totals (5=200, 6=200, 8=200, 7=0), type filters (mcq→4 options+correct in options, match→pairs 3–5), cognitive_level=reasoning (with legacy 'analysis' alias), difficulty=hard, lesson filter using meta-derived lesson, Arabic text search (q=الحاسوب), combined filters, pagination (page1 vs page2 disjoint, pages=10 for grade5), meta endpoint returns 3 units (أساسيات الحاسوب / معالجة الكلمات / الإنترنت) with type counts mcq≈88, true_false=44, short=33, long=22, match=13 and total=200 for grade 5, image serving via /api/static/bank/{grade}/*.jpg returns 200 image/jpeg, create-quiz endpoint drops match questions and preserves image_url on carried-over questions, and admin DELETE of a grade-8 global question drops total from 200→199 (as authorized by review request). Frontend: /teacher/question-bank fully verified via Playwright — stats bar shows 200+type breakdown, all 4 grade tabs present, lesson select has 3 optgroups (12 options), grade-7 shows the book-pending empty state, pagination text 'صفحة 2 من 10 (200 سؤال)' and page1/page2 differ, type filter renders correct MCQ/true_false/short (with working عرض الإجابة النموذجية toggle)/match cards, images from /api/static/bank/5/l11_img{1,2,3}.jpg load with naturalWidth 621–656 (>0), no literal 'IMG1'/'IMG2' anywhere in card text, clear-filters button appears when a search is entered, checkbox selection reveals 'إنشاء اختبار (2)' CTA, quiz modal submits and navigates to /teacher/quiz/{id}/edit (created quiz cleaned up via API after test), and generate modal opens with grade select containing [5,6,8] only (no 7) and 3 topic optgroups. Zero console errors on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_question_bank: pagination clamps limit to min=5. A caller who passes limit=1 or 2 will get 5 — harmless for the current UI (uses limit=20) but surprising for API consumers; consider allowing limit=1 for lightweight fetches (e.g. baseline-total probes).

create-quiz endpoint silently drops match-type questions; this is intended per requirements, but the API response gives no indication of how many were dropped. Consider returning {excluded_count, quiz} so the UI can toast 'تم استبعاد N سؤال توصيل'.

DELETE /question-bank/{qid} on a global question is admin-only but is irreversible; the endpoint has no soft-delete, and the 600-question seed cannot be re-inserted without rerunning the generation script. Consider a soft-delete flag or scope='global_archived' to protect the curated content.

QuestionBank.jsx match card renders pairs with SVG ChevronLeft (no textual arrow), so screen-reader users get no cue about pair direction — add aria-label='يقابل' or a visually hidden text on the arrow.

static mount at end of server.py serves files without any auth; /api/static/bank/*.jpg is intentionally public which is fine, but consider Cache-Control headers to avoid re-fetching 621×… images every navigation.
seed_data_creation: Deleted exactly ONE grade-8 global question via DELETE /api/question-bank/{id} (authorized by review request). Grade-8 total is now 199; grades 5 and 6 remain at 200. Also created and DELETED one draft quiz ('TEST_bank_quiz' / 'TEST_UI_bank_quiz') during create-quiz tests — cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank now holds 599 global questions (200 g5 + 200 g6 + 199 g8). Login is username+password (not password-only). Frontend route is /teacher/question-bank. Backend pagination response is {questions,total,page,pages}. Match questions have a `pairs` array (3–5 entries) and are excluded from create-quiz. Images are at /api/static/bank/{grade}/{filename}.jpg (public, no auth). To further exercise the DELETE endpoint without eroding the seed, hit a non-existent id (returns 404) or a personal question created by generate — do NOT call POST /question-bank/generate as it consumes LLM credits (per review-request policy).
